architecture.summary: Offline batch-oriented forensic triage pipeline running on Linux/Python 3.12+, with immutable evidence-file selection and streaming hash-aware ingestion; distinct contextual parsers for SSH/syslog, HTTP access and configured console messages; transparent source-aware login/injection detection; bounded regex operations and decoding; deterministic on-disk aggregation; redacted JSONL/readable reports and manifest finalized only when source inventory and disposition can be trusted. Seams isolate filesystem, clock, regex timeout engine and output sinks; dependency direction flows from CLI toward pure types and classifiers, not reverse.
interfaces: CLI: python -m security_log_auditor --input PATH [--input PATH...] --rules RULES.toml --output DIR [--from ISO8601] [--to ISO8601] --timezone ZONE (timezone only for otherwise offset-less sources).
FileSource: enumerate(selected) -> source identity/status; chunks(source)->bounded bytes; each gzip file decompressed in bounded increments while raw physical source hash computed.

Parser registry: parse(stream, configured_format)-> ParsedEvent with original file, line_start,line_end, byte-range when possible, raw timestamp, parsed zone/instant or unavailable, typed fields and parser diagnostics.
Detector: classify(event, config, regex_engine) -> zero or more explicit rule hits with severity, explanation, ID/config hash and observation class; one unique event may have multiple hits.
Aggregation: on-disk SQLite/temporary bounded index for deterministic chronological merge/windows; preserve source references and clustering rule explanations; no permanent database server.
Writer: event findings.jsonl, redacted summary.md and optional summary.csv, manifest.json and incomplete run staging directory; output is isolated from evidence.
failure_modes: Unreadable input or gzip integrity error: account source, mark incomplete, do not finalize complete success.
Malformed or missing/ambiguous timestamp: retain raw field, leave absolute time unknown, list as undated; no guessed UTC ordering.
Invalid regex config: reject before ingest with actionable error; per-match timeout or overlarge field: explicit unclassified/review status and warning.
Signal/disk full/output failure: leave distinguishable partial state, nonzero exit, no stale-report append.
Input mutation during read: record mismatch pre/post hash/stat and flag incomplete, never quietly merge inconsistently hashed evidence.
Unknown record structure/invalid encoding/unsupported event: account as unclassified or needs manual review, never silently discard.
security_boundaries: Evidence read-only local file access, explicit directory boundaries and safe symlink/path handling; audit does not execute content or open connections.
Untrusted log text and rule config cannot trigger shell commands; regex library with explicit operation timeout and input-size/normalization limits; fail safe.
Redacted exports/console; raw evidence never copied into ordinary outputs; restricted permissions and output-path isolation.
Producer/parser trust boundary separate from independent label/source oracles; no successful exploit or attacker identity inferred from strings or temporal correlation.

decisions_and_defaults.detail: Choose TOML rules because stdlib tomllib reads locally and versioned config; compiled YAML CLI line is explicitly illustrative, not mandated; ship readable documented rule defaults. Additional YAML adapter is optional and cannot replace TOML tests.

Use regex module per-match timeout with pinned verified offline dependency; stdlib re lacks match timeout. Reject unsafe expressions at validation and record timeouts as review-needed; do not claim timeouts eliminate every DoS mode.
Exit codes proposed 0=complete, 2=completed with warnings, 3=incomplete/failed, 64=invalid usage/config; exact codes are implementation design, not specified in compiler XML.

Threshold values for spray/bursts, max line length, normalizing depth and regex timeout are explicit versioned rule defaults chosen and tuned against empirical data; no numeric value inferred as owner acceptance threshold.
Persist bounded intermediate sorts/window groups using local SQLite temp files with explicit cleanup; source requires bounded RAM and reproducible ordering, not a permanent DB.

Unique-event identity is source file identity + original event bounded line range, not content-only de-dup across exports; aggregate duplicate content may be flagged without losing separate provenance.

security_and_privacy: Offline only, no external uploads/rule downloads, no active attack or commands; untrusted input and filenames sanitized before display; redact tokens/cookies/passwords, persist original source hashes but never modify evidence; validate regex + runtime timeout + limited field length, bound gzip expansion and disk, stage output with incomplete indication on failures; permission tests and no network checks required.
assumptions_and_limitations: The client original full requirements text was not supplied as a separate attachment; source authority is released compiled PFContract and matched compiler receipt, preserving embedded source anchors.
No labeled production logs/analyst annotations supplied yet; final detection precision, recall, and operator acceptance require those future samples; no numerical targets stated.

The source provides no fixed login burst threshold, default timezone, maximum RAM/throughput target, or exact exit codes. Proposed defaults must remain documented configurable engineering choices, not fabricated customer intent.
TOML selection is a design decision; XML shows rules.yaml only in a nonnormative illustration.
Independent institutional review, real Codex source, application tests, Hypothesis/Lean execution and exact-return recheck have not occurred.
